items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Chick Corea. ... Dick Hyman, Chick Corea, and so on. ... Bill Evans. Oscar Peterson. Chick Corea.

ctx.x: Things like that. So it incorporated . . . Or some of Stevie’s music [Stevie Wonder] as well as some of the jazz composers of that time too as well.

A lot of Stevie’s music. Yeah, absolutely. Chick . . . actually I think one of my favorite records of all time is probably that Chick Corea record with. . . I can’t think of the name of it right now . . . with Roy Haynes . . .
